result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers make nearly the same diagnosis and offer the same concrete fixes: a mobile filter drawer with a grid-first layout, 3–5 columns with richer spec cards, a 60–80px title row, filter groups collapsed by default, and 36–48 items per page. A is a little tighter and suggests subcategory navigation. B adds a list-view toggle and per-option filter counts. Neither has a clear advantage, and both stay on layout rather than visual style. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers find the same core problems: the mobile filter stack buries the products, six thin cards carry too little information, the banner wastes the first screen and 24 per page is too few. Both give concrete fixes and stay on layout. B is slightly better: it puts the mobile problem first, makes the card problem tangible with the 'Hex bolt M8 £4.20, box of 10 or 200' example, and adds useful structural points such as subcategory navigation, scroll restoration and fixed-height names.
